_note: Externally reported results, quoted from primary sources accessed 2026-10-27. None of these systems was run for this report. Each value names who measured it. Inklight has not run any of these benchmarks.

parsebench_source.conditions: dataset version, system versions, options and hardware not stated on the leaderboard

ocria1.aggregation: mean of tables, charts, text formatting and text content; visual grounding excluded because OCRia-1 outputs no boxes
ocria1.speed: 2.17 pages/s at 1 request, 10.21 pages/s at 64 concurrent requests, one NVIDIA B200 GPU
ocria1.blog: "87.4 overall" across text content, formatting, tables and charts; https://www.llamaindex.ai/blog/parse-ocria-1

heron.source: Livathinos et al., Advanced Layout Analysis Models for Docling, arXiv:2509.11720, Table 3 and 5

tableformer.source: Nassar et al., TableFormer, arXiv:2203.01017 v2, Tables 2 and 4
tableformer.caveat: the shipped docling-models checkpoint is not stated to be the paper's model

indra_ocr.stated_not_for: complex tables, handwriting, old or faded scans
